description: The plot illustrates the relationship between initial confidence and accuracy for three different models, with accuracy measured on the vertical axis and initial confidence on the horizontal axis. The initial confidence ranges from 0.91 to 0.98, with values marked at intervals of 0.01. Accuracy is scaled from 0.0 to 1.0. The blue line, marked with circles, starts at an accuracy of approximately 0.85 at an initial confidence of 0.91, rises to a peak of 1.0 at 0.92, and then remains at or near 1.0 through 0.98. The orange dashed line with diamond markers begins at an accuracy of 0.65 at 0.91, peaks at 1.0 at 0.92, and then steadily declines to 0.1 at 0.98. The green dotted line with square markers starts at an accuracy of 0.2 at 0.91, drops to 0.05 at 0.92, rises to 0.25 at 0.94, and continues to increase to approximately 0.9 at 0.98. Error bars are present for each data point, indicating variability in the measurements.
